name: Honda Rebel 500
engine: 471 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: A top-selling cruiser. Most owners here are keeping a modern bike healthy, so check the recalls first.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Rebel 500s from 2017-2023 and 2025 are in recall 26V500 for the handlebar lock screw, and some 2020-2021 bikes had a rear reflector recall (21V382). Book any open recall with a Honda dealer.
A-002.reason: Recall work is free, and the handlebar screw can interfere with steering.

A: 2017-2018 bikes also had an EVAP canister hose service campaign (Honda KJ3). Ask the dealer whether yours was done.

recalls.what: Handlebar lock screw can loosen and fall between the frame and steering stem.
recalls.fix: Free repair at a Honda dealer (Honda code KUO).

recalls.what: Rear reflector may be too dim.

known.title: EVAP canister hose
known.what: 2017-2018 service campaign for a hose that lets fuel vapor through.
